summary: Trimble Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the immediate resignation of director Mark S. Peek, who also stepped down as Audit Committee Chair and from memberships on the Audit and Nominating Committees. The resignation is not due to any disagreement with the company. Concurrently, Thomas Sweet was appointed Audit Committee Chair to oversee remediation of material weaknesses expected to be completed by 2027. The board was reduced from nine to eight members. This abrupt departure, tied to internal control remediation, constitutes a forced/abrupt board change that is itself the event, not a routine meeting notice.
